title: Say it out loud
caption: His hands are for the wheel, not for typing. Tariq talks instead. The founder tells his story.
linkedin_text:
Typing takes hands and quiet that a lot of people do not have at the moment they want to say something.

On Waypoint you can record up to sixty seconds, pick a Bear, Fox or Sparrow voice, and the Wall plays your words in that character's voice. Voice posts go after seven days. The founder character tells Tariq's story; every screen is the real app.

cast.tariq: Tariq, an Indian taxi driver in his forties with a trimmed grey-streaked beard, a white kurta and a small prayer cap

scenes.clip: the founder, a young Indian man with a short beard in a black-and-white floral shirt and khaki shorts, facing the camera beside a yellow taxi on a quiet city street at night, a friendly smile.
scenes.vo: Hi. This is Tariq's story. He drives a taxi. His hands are for the wheel, not for typing.
scenes.sub: Hi. This is Tariq's story. He drives a taxi. His hands are for the wheel, not for typing.
scenes.title: Say it out loud

scenes.clip: {tariq} in the driver's seat of a parked taxi at night, rain on the windscreen, a phone propped on the dashboard, a thoughtful look.
scenes.vo: Between fares he has things to say, and thumbs are slow.
scenes.sub: Between fares he has things to say, and thumbs are slow.

scenes.clip: {tariq} speaking into a phone propped on the dashboard of his parked taxi at night, rain on the glass, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: On Waypoint he taps Voice and talks. Up to sixty seconds.
scenes.sub: On Waypoint he taps Voice and talks. Up to sixty seconds.

scenes.clip: {tariq} looking at his phone and smiling as he chooses between three little animal characters, soft dashboard glow, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: Then he picks a character: a Bear, a Fox or a Sparrow.
scenes.sub: Then he picks a character: a Bear, a Fox or a Sparrow.

scenes.clip: A phone on a wooden table in a bright kitchen playing a soft voice, a young woman listening with a small smile, morning light, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: On the Wall, people hear his words in that character's voice. A voice post goes after seven days.
scenes.sub: On the Wall, people hear his words in that character's voice. A voice post goes after seven days.

scenes.clip: {tariq} driving his taxi through evening traffic with a light relaxed smile, city lights blurring past.
scenes.vo: Parked, said it, back to the next fare.
scenes.sub: Parked, said it, back to the next fare.

scenes.vo: Waypoint. Say it once. Free on Google Play.
